character_fit.label: Fitness proportions
character_fit.reason: Original straight-arm reach cannot clear the head.

timing.source: declared demonstration tempo; not measured from source photographs

pulldown_range.method: all-frame elbow-to-wrist direction and recorded bottom-phase elbow/torso geometry

pulldown_profile.method: declared fitted overhead-extension to upper-chest path; uncalibrated photo depth is not treated as a mechanical target

arm_roll.method: fixed mirrored humerus roll from the fitted clavicle rest frame for a front pulldown; solved elbow, wrist and grip retained

rows.note: Reach adaptation changes the photographed equipment path.
Conservative shaft/body surface samples; overlap candidates need visual review.
Both handles must reach above the head; a secure grip alone does not establish the required movement range.
The forearms point upward to the handle throughout the pulldown.
At the recorded chest position both elbows must be below their shoulders.
The elbows pull down beside the torso rather than remaining above the body.
Both elbows extend to at least 175 degrees at the top of the cable return.
A full pulldown requires meaningful bar travel from overhead toward the upper chest.
Feet must reach the floor.
Feet must reach the floor.

Folds hidden from every view at the right shoulder (up to 442 mm², 27 of 32 frames), the left shoulder (up to 376 mm², 24 of 32 frames), the right elbow (up to 152 mm², 3 of 32 frames) and the left collarbone (up to 100 mm², frame 29); plus creases at the elbows, which are normal in deep bends
